readings: For each invoice number in `Invoice_Line_Items`, give the invoice number, the invoice's cost ratio, its number of line items, and its relative ratio. To get the invoice's cost ratio, divide `derived_product_cost` by `derived_total_cost` on each of its lines and average those line ratios, ignoring missing ones. The relative ratio is the invoice's cost ratio divided by the average of all invoices' cost ratios (ignoring missing values). Return rows only when that overall average exists. Sort by the relative ratio from highest to lowest, with missing values last, show the top 10, and don't round anything.
queries:
WITH invoice_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost) AS cost_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio
  FROM invoice_ratios
)
SELECT
  i.invoice_number,
  i.cost_ratio,
  i.line_item_count,
  i.cost_ratio / o.average_cost_ratio AS relative_ratio
FROM invoice_ratios AS i
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
